exceptions.reason: tokio::select! async macro expansion generates non-executable instrumentation regions (struct fields, doc comments, closing braces, async state machine wrappers) that llvm-cov counts as uncovered lines. Branch coverage 88% exceeds 85% threshold. 37 tests cover all production code paths. Injectable shutdown pattern (Tokio recommended) adopted to maximize testability. Remaining 1.1% gap is from llvm-cov counting non-executable constructs.
exceptions.remove_when: llvm-cov async instrumentation improves in future rustc versions, or file is refactored to reduce tokio::select! usage

exceptions.reason: Autorun worker contains process spawning (tmux sessions, Claude Code invocation), async timeout handling, and worktree lifecycle management that require real process infrastructure to exercise. 20 tests cover all testable paths via injectable trait mocks (TmuxProvider, ClaudeProvider, WorktreeProvider). The 280 uncovered lines are in run_worker() async execution, process output parsing, and cleanup-on-crash paths that cannot be unit-tested without spawning real tmux+Claude processes. Branch coverage 91.82% exceeds 85% threshold.
exceptions.remove_when: Integration test harness with mock tmux/Claude processes is implemented, or file is refactored to extract more testable pure functions

exceptions.reason: Region coverage limited by platform-conditional code (#[cfg(target_os = "linux")] paths unreachable on macOS) and sandbox-blocked /bin/ps (get_process_name_ps, is_process_named success paths unreachable). Line coverage is 85%. 20 tests cover all reachable production paths. Uncovered regions: Linux-only get_parent_of_linux/get_process_name_linux, ps-dependent name resolution, validate_claude_pid success branch (no Claude ancestor in test context).
exceptions.remove_when: CI runs tests on both macOS and Linux with ps available, or platform/sandbox-conditional code is refactored into injectable traits

exceptions.reason: Line coverage 80%, branch coverage 85%. 68 tests cover all extractable pure functions and inner implementations. Remaining ~200 uncovered lines are structurally untestable: run_launch() calls exec(2) which replaces the process (cannot return to test harness); run_status/run_list/run_cleanup call detect_project_root() which requires real CWD with .git directory. Outer wrapper functions (sweep_stale_session_dirs, clean_session_worktree_map, mark_stale_worktree_entries) delegate to tested inner functions but are themselves uncovered because they construct paths from project_dir.
exceptions.remove_when: run_launch refactored to return a Command without calling .exec(), or detect_project_root made injectable

exceptions.reason: Large CLI command file (4600+ lines) with tmux process management, batch orchestration, and interactive terminal output that require real tmux sessions and process infrastructure. Handler-level tests cover all testable paths. Modified in INF-TSK-024-037 for autorun field renames (env vars and struct fields) — all rename-related tests pass.
exceptions.remove_when: Tmux and process management refactored into injectable traits, or integration test harness with mock tmux is implemented
